steps.npc: No and even if I did have one I wouldn't give it to you!

steps.text: If the player has a lockpick:

steps.player: I already have one. I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.

steps.text: If the player does not have a lockpick:

steps.player: I was just letting you know that having a lockpick helps when getting into these coffins. You appear to be struggling.

steps.npc: Wait, are you serious? The last adventurer I spoke to down here told me that lockpicks don't help!

steps.player: Yes I'm serious. Also that outfit you're wearing doesn't help you get more loot from these coffins either.

steps.npc: They lied about that too? I feel like a fool!

steps.player: At least you look cool dressed like that though.

steps.npc: Who cares about that? If it doesn't work then I should just wear the full graceful outfit since that would be much more efficient.

steps.player: Each to their own I suppose.
